outcome: A copy of an adventurer card has the same alternative Adventure characteristics as the original.
Drawing or discarding an adventurer card moves one card, not two.
Casting as an Adventure is judged only on the Adventure's cost, type and targets, so can_play differs from casting the creature half.
A spell cast as an Adventure has only the Adventure's name, cost, type and text while on the stack.
A copy of an Adventure spell is an Adventure with the Adventure's characteristics.
An Adventure spell that resolves is exiled instead of going to the graveyard, and its controller may later cast the creature half from exile but not the Adventure.
Outside the stack, and on the stack when not cast as an Adventure, the card has only its normal characteristics.
